API guides · Live evidence · OpenAPI YAML

Atreides API reference

The REST API under /v1. Every answer is an envelope: `{ ok: true, data }` or, for a decided refusal, HTTP 200 with `{ ok: false, code, message, retryable, requestId }`; transport errors carry the same body with their HTTP status. Inside v1 changes are additive only: ignore fields you do not know and map codes and enum values you do not know to a generic case.

OpenAPI 3.1.0 · API 1.0.0 · 258 operations

API origin https://api.atreides.finance. Check live evidence and gate states before relying on an operation.

GET /v1/venues/binance/status

Read the Binance phase and product gate states.

Operation ID
getBinanceStatus
Access
session or apiKey
Rate class
read
Idempotency
none
Responses
{
  "200": {
    "description": "The result, or a refusal.",
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "oneOf": [
            {
              "type": "object",
              "required": [
                "ok",
                "data"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "ok": {
                  "const": true
                },
                "data": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Status"
                }
              }
            },
            {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Refusal"
            }
          ]
        },
        "example": {
          "ok": true,
          "data": {
            "phase": "BN0",
            "products": {
              "spot": "closed",
              "usdm": "closed"
            },
            "codesLive": {
              "spot": false,
              "usdm": false
            },
            "fastApiLive": false
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
Refusal codes
[]

Rate class
connect

target

          "signatures"

GET /v1/auth/discord/callback

Finish the Discord sign-in or link: Discord returns here.

Answers 302 to the `returnTo` of the start, with `?signin=ok` or `?signin=<code>` where the code is `discord_auth_failed`, `invite_required`, `invite_invalid` or `identity_linked_elsewhere`. A redirect cannot carry a 503, so an unreachable Discord is `discord_auth_failed` too. When the state is unknown there is no return path, and the answer is the 200 refusal. Sets the session cookie on success and clears `__Host-oauth`. When the user declined, Discord sends `error` and no `code`.

Records that the signed-in user accepted `version`, with the instant and the client IP. Only the version the operator requires (`termsVersionRequired` of `getMe`) is accepted. POST /v1/api-keys

Create an API key or an MCP token.

An `ed25519` key registers the public key the client made and keeps the private key to itself; a trade key also needs the wallet grant of the signing rules. An `mcp_token` answers its token once, in `token`. At most ten keys are active or rotating. Needs the second factor when it is on, except for a trade key, whose grant already counts.

POST /v1/panic

Stop everything the user has opening.

Trade scope or session. Blocks every opening order of the user, whatever the key, the session or the ticket (`key_frozen`), then cancels the resting opening orders on every account of the user. With `cancelProtective` the reduce-only orders go too. It never closes a position and never touches the dead-man. Closes stay possible. Repeating it is harmless: it blocks again and cancels what rests.

panic

An intent the gateway signs, or a relay payload the user's own key signed. A reduce-only order is rate-classed `protect` from its body, any other `order`. POST /v1/orders/batch

Place up to 20 orders in one call.

Trade scope. Each item is an independent order: the answer is HTTP 200 with one result per item in request order, and an item refused does not stop the others. One `Idempotency-Key` replays the whole answer. The call draws one `order` token (`protect` when every item is reduce-only); every item still counts in the key's per-minute limit and in the venue budget. Items for one account go in the order given. A relay, a routed order, `routeId` or `strategyRunId` in any item refuses the whole batch `invalid_request` before anything is sent.

Operation ID
placeOrdersBatch
Access
session or apiKey
Rate class
order
Idempotency
header

    "$ref": "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
  }
]

      "schema": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/BatchPlaceRequest"
      },

        "orders": [
          {
            "accountId": "01936f2e-7c3a-7b1e-8d4f-2a9c5e6b7d10",
            "clientOrderId": "mm-000001",
            "instrumentId": "hyperliquid:BTC",
            "side": "buy",
            "type": "limit",
            "price": "64990",
            "size": "0.01"
          },
          {
            "accountId": "01936f2e-7c3a-7b1e-8d4f-2a9c5e6b7d10",

POST /v1/accounts/{accountId}/isolated-margin

Add margin to, or remove it from, an isolated position.

Trade scope. A positive `amountUsd` adds, a negative one removes; `amountUsd` is a change, not a target, so a repeat would change the margin twice: send an `Idempotency-Key`, and retry a lost answer with the same key. No route moves funds. Refused `feature_unavailable` until the gateway has the adjust-margin action.

GET /v1/stream

Open the WebSocket stream.

Upgrades to a WebSocket whose JSON text frames are `StreamClientFrame` and `StreamServerFrame`. The server sends `hello` first. Browsers authenticate with the session cookie and an allowed Origin; bots sign the upgrade request; an anonymous socket may subscribe to public channels only. `user` needs read scope and `heartbeat` trade scope. Close codes: 1000 normal; 1012 server restart (reconnect after `reconnectAfterMs` with `since`); 4001 not authenticated; 4003 channel not readable by the principal; 4008 slow consumer (send buffer over 1 MiB, reconnect with `since`); 4009 session or key revoked or expired (stop); 4029 over the stream rate class. Documented here and served by the stream handler, not the registrar.

Operation ID
openStream
Access
Public or session or apiKey
Rate class
stream
Idempotency
none
Parameters
[
  {
    "name": "since",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "description": "Decimal `seq` of the `user` channel to resume after.",
    "schema": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9]+$"
    }
  },
  {
    "name": "channels",
    "in": "query",
    "required": false,
    "description": "Channels to subscribe to on connect, as a comma list.",
    "schema": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Channel"
      }
    },
    "style": "form",
    "explode": false
  }
]
Responses
{
  "101": {
    "description": "Switching Protocols: the socket is open. Frames follow the schemas named in `x-stream`."
  }
}

Paused runs stay paused; the user resumes each. Lab objects move no money, so a `read` key may write them; an MCP token is refused `scope_missing`.

A validation answer, not a refusal: `data.ok` tells whether the spec is accepted. With a `window`, the answer adds the data coverage and a runtime estimate. Writes nothing.

Ok
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "A success. An operation's answer is this envelope with `data` narrowed to its own schema, as `allOf: [Ok, { type: object, required: [data], properties: { data: <schema> } }]`, or `oneOf` that and Refusal.",
  "required": [
    "ok",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ok": {
      "const": true
    },
    "data": {}
  }
}
OkList
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "A page of a list, newest first unless the operation says otherwise. Pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page; it is null on the last page. An operation narrows `data.items` the same way as Ok.",
  "required": [
    "ok",
    "data",
    "nextCursor"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ok": {
      "const": true
    },
    "data": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {}
    },
    "nextCursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Opaque. Valid for the same operation and filters as long as its rows exist."
    }
  }
}
Refusal
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "A refusal or an error. `code` names the cause, `message` says how to fix it; map the code, not the text.",
  "required": [
    "ok",
    "code",
    "message",
    "retryable",
    "requestId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "ok": {
      "const": false
    },
    "code": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorCode"
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "retryable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True when the same request may succeed later unchanged."
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "The values the message was filled from.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "number",
          "boolean",
          "null"
        ]
      }
    },
    "requestId": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Equals the X-Request-Id header of the answer; quote it when asking for help."
    }
  }
}
DecStr
{
  "type": "string",
  "description": "A canonical decimal, at most 20 integer and 18 fraction digits. Money and sizes are never JSON numbers.",
  "pattern": "^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19})(\\.[0-9]{1,18})?$",
  "examples": [
    "0",
    "-12.5",
    "0.000000000000000001"
  ]
}
Instant
{
  "type": "string",
  "format": "date-time",
  "description": "A moment in UTC, always with three fraction digits and a Z.",
  "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\\.[0-9]{3}Z$",
  "examples": [
    "2026-11-07T09:30:00.000Z"
  ]
}
Uuid
{
  "type": "string",
  "format": "uuid",
  "description": "An id, a lowercase UUIDv7.",
  "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$",
  "examples": [
    "01936f2e-7c3a-7b1e-8d4f-2a9c5e6b7d80"
  ]
}
Hex
{
  "type": "string",
  "description": "Bytes as 0x and an even number of hex digits.",
  "pattern": "^0x([0-9a-fA-F]{2})*$",
  "examples": [
    "0x",
    "0xdeadbeef"
  ]
}
ClientOrderId
{
  "type": "string",
  "description": "The caller's id for an order. Sending the same id with the same body again returns the stored order.",

  "examples": [
    "bot-7-000123"

}

    "type",
    "route",
    "clientRouteId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "group": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 128
    },
    "side": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "buy",
        "sell"
      ]
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "limit",
        "market"
      ]
    },
    "tif": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "ioc",
        "gtc",
        "post_only"
      ]
    },
    "price": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "size": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "notional": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "reduceOnly": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "maxSlippageBps": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 2000
    },
    "tp": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TriggerJson"
    },
    "sl": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TriggerJson"
    },
    "fundingHorizonHours": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 8760
    },
    "split": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "maxLegs": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 8
    },
    "crossClass": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "allowPartial": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "onShortfall": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "keep",
        "unwind"
      ],
      "description": "Defaults to keep. Unwind requests a separate protective close after all available execution waves."
    },
    "accountIds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 100,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "gateway",
        "direct"
      ]
    },
    "route": {
      "const": "best"
    },
    "clientRouteId": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ClientOrderId"
    },
    "quoteId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 16384
    },
    "replan": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 2
    }
  },
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "required": [
        "size"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "notional"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "required": [
        "notional"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "size"
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "allOf": [
    {
      "not": {
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "const": "limit"
          }
        },
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "not": {
              "required": [
                "price",
                "size"
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "required": [
              "notional"
            ]
          },
          {
            "required": [
              "maxSlippageBps"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "not": {
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "const": "market"
          }
        },
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "required": [
              "price"
            ]
          },

          "size"
        ]

      "not": {

                "size"
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "required": [
              "notional"
            ]
          },
          {
            "required": [
              "maxSlippageBps"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "not": {
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "const": "market"
          }
        },
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "required": [
              "price"
            ]
          },
          {
            "required": [
              "tif"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "tif": {
                "not": {
                  "const": "ioc"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

RoutePreviewRequest
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "An indicative route quote needs no account. Exactly one of size (base units) and notional (USD).",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "group",
    "side"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "group": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 128,
      "description": "The instrument group, for example perp:BTC, spot:ETH/USDC, stock:NVDA or single:<instrumentId>."
    },
    "side": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "buy",
        "sell"
      ]
    },
    "size": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "notional": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "price": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "maxSlippageBps": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 2000
    },
    "includeVenues": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/RoutePreviewVenueId"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 15,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "excludeVenues": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/RoutePreviewVenueId"
      },
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 15,
      "uniqueItems": true
    },
    "fundingHorizonHours": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 8760
    },
    "split": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "maxLegs": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 8
    }
  },
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "required": [
        "size"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "notional"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "required": [
        "notional"
      ],
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "size"
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "allOf": [
    {
      "not": {
        "required": [
          "price"
        ],
        "anyOf": [
          {
            "required": [
              "maxSlippageBps"
            ]
          },
          {
            "required": [
              "notional"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

              "type": "integer"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        },
        "fundingHorizonHours": {

              "type": "integer"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]

PlaceOrderIntent
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "An order the gateway signs for the caller.",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "accountId",
    "clientOrderId",
    "instrumentId",
    "side",
    "type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "accountId": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
    },
    "clientOrderId": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ClientOrderId"
    },
    "instrumentId": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "\"<venue>:<venueSymbol>\"."
    },
    "side": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "buy",
        "sell"
      ]
    },
    "type": {
      "description": "A market order is an IOC bounded by the price band. The four trigger types (`stop_market`, `stop_limit`, `take_market`, `take_limit`) carry `triggerPx`; a venue that does not hold them itself refuses them `order_type_unsupported`, and we never hold a trigger for you (05 §10b.1). No venue lists them yet.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "limit",
        "market",
        "stop_market",
        "stop_limit",
        "take_market",
        "take_limit"
      ]
    },
    "triggerPx": {
      "description": "Required for a trigger type, and only for it. A `_limit` type also carries `price`.",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "dryRun": {
      "description": "Run the checks of 05 §3.3 steps 1 to 4 (state, fee, band, quantization, limits, frozen mode) and answer `DryRunResult`: nothing is stored, signed or sent, and no budget is taken. A plain intent only (no `routeId`, no `strategyRunId`).",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "tif": {
      "description": "Default: gtc for a limit order, ioc for a market order.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "gtc",
        "ioc",
        "fok",
        "post_only",
        "gtd"
      ]
    },
    "price": {
      "description": "Required for a limit order.",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "size": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "notional": {
      "description": "Market buys only, where the venue sizes in quote. Exactly one of `size` and `notional`.",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "reduceOnly": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "goodTil": {
      "description": "Required when `tif` is gtd.",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Instant"
    },
    "tp": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TriggerJson"
    },
    "sl": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/TriggerJson"
    },
    "slippageBps": {
      "description": "Swap venues: the floor below the quote the user accepts, bounded by the price band.",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "routeId": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
    },
    "strategyRunId": {
      "description": "A gateway-mode strategy run's order.",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
    }
  }
}

  "required": [
    "fillId",
    "accountId",
    "venue",
    "instrumentId",
    "side",
    "liquidity",
    "price",
    "size",
    "notional",
    "venueFee",
    "ourFee",
    "state",
    "mode",
    "origin",
    "orderId",
    "clientOrderId",
    "venueFillId",
    "at"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fillId": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
    },
    "accountId": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
    },
    "venue": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/VenueId"
    },
    "instrumentId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "side": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "buy",
        "sell"
      ]
    },
    "liquidity": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "maker",
            "taker"
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "price": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "size": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "notional": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "venueFee": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/MoneyJson"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "ourFee": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/MoneyJson"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "provisional",
        "reconciled"
      ]
    },
    "mode": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Mode"
    },
    "origin": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "orderId": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "clientOrderId": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "venueFillId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "at": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Instant"
    }
  }
}
EquityView
{
  "type": "object",

    "current",
    "daily"
  ],

      "type": "array",

          },
          "equity": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/MoneyJson"
          },
          "source": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
FillExplanation

  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "fill",

    "reconciliation",
    "rewards"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "fill": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Fill"
    },
    "rate": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "tierName",
        "origin",
        "ruleVersion",
        "cappedBy"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "tierName": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "origin": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "ruleVersion": {
          "type": "string"
        },

          "oneOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        }
      }

      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "state",
        "venueDay"

      "properties": {
        "state": {
          "type": "string",

            "held"

          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/UtcDay"
        }
      }
    },
    "rewards": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "referral",
        "state"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "referral": {
          "oneOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/MoneyJson"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        },
        "state": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

MonitorPoint
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "at",
    "requests",
    "refused",
    "rateLimited",
    "latencyMs",
    "streamConnects"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "at": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Instant"
    },
    "requests": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "refused": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 0
      },
      "description": "Count by error code."
    },
    "rateLimited": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Requests refused by a rate limit. // money-ok: a count of requests, not money"
    },
    "latencyMs": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": [
        "p50",
        "p95",
        "max"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "p50": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "p95": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "max": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        }
      }
    },
    "streamConnects": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    }
  }
}
MonitorView
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "from",
    "bucket",
    "series",
    "venueRejects"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Instant"
    },

      "type": "string",
      "enum": [

        "5m"
      ]
    },
    "series": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "principal",
          "points"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "principal": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "\"key:<keyText>\" or \"session\"."
          },
          "points": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/components/schemas/MonitorPoint"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "venueRejects": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "venue",
          "code",
          "count"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "venue": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/VenueId"
          },
          "code": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "count": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 0
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

Rewards
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "userId",
    "referral",
    "prizes",
    "claimableUsdc",
    "minClaimUsdc",
    "waiting",
    "openClaim",
    "claimsHalted"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "userId": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
    },
    "referral": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ReferralBalances"
      }
    },
    "prizes": {
      "description": "Cash prize credits, USDC.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/RewardBalances"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "returnedFees": {
      "description": "Returned route fees, grouped by asset.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/RewardBalances"
      }
    },
    "claimableUsdc": {
      "description": "Claimable converted to USDC at fresh rates; null when any claimable asset lacks a fresh rate.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "minClaimUsdc": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "waiting": {
      "description": "Why pending shares are not claimable yet.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "venue",
          "day",
          "state",
          "amount",
          "reason"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "venue": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/VenueId"
          },
          "day": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/UtcDay"
          },
          "state": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "open",
              "awaiting_record",
              "awaiting_manual",
              "awaiting_payout",
              "held"
            ]
          },
          "amount": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/MoneyJson"
          },
          "reason": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "day_open",
              "record_pending",
              "manual_record",
              "payout_pending",
              "held"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "openClaim": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Claim"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "claimsHalted": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}

Channel
{
  "type": "string",
  "description": "user, venues, research_cards, book:<instrumentId>, trades:<instrumentId>, candles:<instrumentId>:<tf>, mark:<instrumentId>.",
  "pattern": "^(user|venues|research_cards|book:.+|trades:.+|candles:.+:(1m|5m|15m|1h|4h|1d)|mark:.+)$",
  "examples": [
    "user",
    "book:hyperliquid:BTC"
  ]
}
StreamClientFrame
{
  "description": "A JSON text frame from the client, at most 64 KiB.",
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "op",
        "id",
        "channels"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "const": "subscribe"
        },
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64
        },
        "channels": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Channel"
          }
        },
        "since": {
          "description": "Decimal `seq` of the `user` channel to resume after.",
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[0-9]+$"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "op",
        "id",
        "channels"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "const": "unsubscribe"
        },
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64
        },
        "channels": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Channel"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "op",
        "id"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "const": "ping"
        },
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Refreshes the dead-man of these accounts, as POST /v1/deadman with the armed timeout. Trade scope or session.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "op",
        "id",
        "accountIds"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "op": {
          "const": "heartbeat"
        },
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 64
        },
        "accountIds": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "discriminator": {
    "propertyName": "op"
  }
}
StreamServerFrame
{
  "description": "A JSON text frame from the server. `hello` comes first.",
  "oneOf": [
    {

    "accountIds",
    "limits"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9 ._-]{1,40}$"
    },
    "lang": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/BotLang"
    },
    "template": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [

        "dca",
        "grid"
      ]

      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "maxItems": 20,
      "uniqueItems": true,
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
      }
    },
    "limits": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/BotLimitsInput"
    },
    "schedule": {
      "description": "`forever` (default) or a run every `everyS` seconds.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "forever"
        },
        {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "required": [
            "everyS"
          ],
          "properties": {

              "type": "integer",

              "maximum": 86400
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    },

      "type": "integer",

      "minimum": 5000,
      "maximum": 600000
    }

ExecutionReport
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "What an order cost and how fast it went, every figure from the record. A figure the record cannot give is null, never zero. Slippage is positive when it is worse for the trader (signed against the side). The arrival is the book at the moment the request reached the API (`arrivalSource` book or cache) or, when no book was held, the mark at that moment (`arrivalSource` mark, no `arrivalMid`).",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "arrivalMid",
    "arrivalMark",
    "arrivalSource",
    "vwap",
    "slippageVsArrivalBps",
    "slippageVsMidBps",
    "filledSize",
    "fills",
    "venueFeeUsd",
    "ourFeeUsd",
    "decisionMs",
    "msToAck",
    "msToFirstFill",
    "provisional"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "arrivalMid": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "arrivalMark": {
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "arrivalSource": {
      "description": "Where the arrival price came from. Null when the order has no arrival record at all.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "book",
            "cache",
            "mark"
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "vwap": {
      "description": "Volume-weighted average fill price over the order's fills.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "slippageVsArrivalBps": {
      "description": "Basis points of VWAP against the arrival price (the arrival mid, else the arrival mark).",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "slippageVsMidBps": {
      "description": "Basis points of VWAP against the arrival mid. Null when no mid was held at arrival.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "filledSize": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
    },
    "fills": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0
    },
    "venueFeeUsd": {
      "description": "The venue's own fee in USD at each fill's time. Null when any fill lacks a fee or a USD rate.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "ourFeeUsd": {
      "description": "Our whole fee in USD, one figure. Null when any fill lacks it.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DecStr"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "decisionMs": {
      "description": "Milliseconds from the API accepting the request to the order being signed for sending.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "msToAck": {
      "description": "Milliseconds from the API accepting the request to the venue's answer.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "msToFirstFill": {
      "description": "Milliseconds from the API accepting the request to the first fill's venue time. Null with no fill.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "provisional": {
      "description": "True while the order is not final or any fill is not yet confirmed.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  }
}

    },

      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/KeyPublicKey"
    },
    "scopes": {
      "description": "`['read']` or `['read', 'trade']`. An `mcp_token` with `trade` is an agent token (API-073): bound accounts, `expiresAt` within 90 days, and `limits.maxOrderNotional` and `limits.dailyNotional`.",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/KeyScopes"
    },
    "accounts": {
      "description": "Venue account ids the key may act on. `all` only for a key whose scopes are `['read']`.",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/KeyAccounts"
    },

      "type": "array",

      "maxItems": 16,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 49
      }
    },
    "expiresAt": {
      "description": "Required for a trade key (at most 365 days ahead; 365 days if left out) and for an agent token (at most 90 days ahead, no default). Optional for others (at most 2 years).",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Instant"
    },
    "grant": {
      "description": "Required when an `ed25519` key's `scopes` has `trade`; never on an `mcp_token`.",
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/KeyGrant"
    },
    "limits": {
      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ApiKeyLimitsInput"
    }
  }
}

      "description": "Smart routing for the terminal's ticket (05 section 10b.11); \"on\" when absent. It never affects a close, a cancel, a reduce-only order, or an order that asks for the router by name."
    },
    "dismissedHints": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]{2,63}$"
      },
      "maxItems": 100
    }
  }
}

{

headers

X-Request-Id
{
  "description": "Sent on every answer. A UUIDv7 made on arrival, or the caller's X-Request-Id when it is a valid UUIDv7 not seen in the last minute. Equals `requestId` in a refusal body; quote it when asking for help.",
  "required": true,
  "schema": {
    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
  }
}
RateLimit-Limit
{
  "description": "The size of the tightest token bucket that applies to this request.",
  "required": true,
  "schema": {
    "type": "integer",
    "minimum": 0
  }
}
RateLimit-Remaining
{
  "description": "Tokens left in that bucket.",
  "required": true,
  "schema": {
    "type": "integer",
    "minimum": 0
  }
}
RateLimit-Reset
{
  "description": "Seconds until that bucket is full again.",
  "required": true,
  "schema": {
    "type": "integer",
    "minimum": 0
  }
}
Retry-After
{
  "description": "Sent with 429. Seconds to wait, rounded up.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "integer",
    "minimum": 0
  }
}
Deprecation
{
  "description": "Sent by a deprecated operation.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string"
  }
}
Sunset
{
  "description": "Sent by a deprecated operation. The date after which it may stop answering.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string"
  }
}

parameters

IdempotencyKey
{
  "name": "Idempotency-Key",
  "in": "header",
  "required": true,
  "description": "Required by operations whose `x-idempotency` is `header`. The same key with the same request returns the stored answer for 24 hours; the same key with another request is 409 `idempotency_conflict`.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string",
    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,64}$"
  },
  "example": "3f9d2c1a-7b44-4e0a"
}
SecondFactor
{
  "name": "X-Second-Factor",
  "in": "header",
  "required": false,
  "description": "The authenticator code, for the operations that ask for it when the user has turned it on. A missing or wrong code is the refusal `second_factor_required` or `second_factor_invalid`. Sessions only.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string",
    "minLength": 1,
    "maxLength": 32
  },
  "example": "123456"
}
XApiKey
{
  "name": "X-Api-Key",
  "in": "header",
  "required": true,
  "description": "The key text, `live_…` or `test_…`.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string"
  },
  "example": "live_abc"
}
XApiTimestamp
{
  "name": "X-Api-Timestamp",
  "in": "header",
  "required": true,
  "description": "Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, as a decimal string.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string",
    "pattern": "^[0-9]{1,16}$"
  },
  "example": "1794043800000"
}
XApiNonce
{
  "name": "X-Api-Nonce",
  "in": "header",
  "required": true,
  "description": "16 to 64 characters, never used before with this key. The SDKs send 22 characters of base64url.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string",
    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$"
  },
  "example": "5h0Qd3nXwV1uYz8aB2cE7g"
}
XApiSignature
{
  "name": "X-Api-Signature",
  "in": "header",
  "required": true,
  "description": "The base64url, without padding, of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature of the signed string (03 §5.3).",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string",
    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{86}$"
  },
  "example": "5h0Qd3nXwV1uYz8aB2cE7g5h0Qd3nXwV1uYz8aB2cE7g5h0Qd3nXwV1uYz8aB2cE7g5h0Qd3nXwV1uYz8aB2cE7g"
}
Cursor
{
  "name": "cursor",
  "in": "query",
  "required": false,
  "description": "The `nextCursor` of the previous page of the same operation and filters. Opaque. A cursor from another list or other filters is refused with `cursor_invalid`.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string",
    "minLength": 1,
    "maxLength": 512,
    "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$"
  }
}
Limit
{
  "name": "limit",
  "in": "query",
  "required": false,
  "description": "The most rows to return.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "integer",
    "minimum": 1,
    "maximum": 500,
    "default": 100
  }
}
From
{
  "name": "from",
  "in": "query",
  "required": false,
  "description": "Only rows at or after this instant.",
  "schema": {
    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Instant"
  }
}
To
{
  "name": "to",
  "in": "query",
  "required": false,
  "description": "Only rows up to this instant.",
  "schema": {
    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Instant"
  }
}
AccountId
{
  "name": "accountId",
  "in": "query",
  "required": false,
  "description": "Only this venue account. A key bound to other accounts is refused with `account_not_bound`.",
  "schema": {
    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
  }
}
Venue
{
  "name": "venue",
  "in": "query",
  "required": false,
  "description": "Only this venue.",
  "schema": {
    "$ref": "#/components/schemas/VenueId"
  }
}
venue
{
  "in": "path",
  "name": "venue",
  "required": true,
  "description": "The exchange OAuth program.",
  "schema": {
    "type": "string",
    "enum": [
      "bybit",
      "okx"
    ]
  }
}
